title: Accessible coach: side-loading doors, boarding and restraint interfaces
normal_boarding: Side-loading through42-inch structural side portal with36-inch actual clear guarded path. NegativeY illustrated; physical handing provisional until station coordination. Both stations use same normal boarding/unloading side. Enddoors are not the normal ADA boarding path.
completed_scope: Accessible side portal relocates C1 post25:42in structural opening,36in clear guarded boarding path,78in clear height.
Offset enddoor portal36 clear atY−12..24, actual steel leaves, interleaved hinges, retained pins and two independently operated captive shoot bolts.
Original36-clear station-owned bridge with boxed transverse headers, pinned coach clevises, captured station shoes, transition plate, edge curbs and removable handrails.
Station storage rack with removable bolted retaining bar and actual stored-bridge fit. Complete lockable retractor cabinet reserved outside enddoor route.
Split underfloor restraint support members fitted between main girder and existing seat rails; separate short-track pockets avoid girder through-bolts.
Both actual guarded bridge approaches swept with one reversal, fixed passengers, other wheelchair and other-bay retractor reservations. Full30x48proxy clears side guards before turning.
unfinished: Bridge concentrated near-end/interface structural screens fail. Header, tongue/notch and connection load paths require redesign and qualification before passenger use.
Site height/gap, stopping tolerance, body roll/pitch and final suspension range.
Complete accessible shell framing/skin/glazing, weather seals, body structural analysis and manufacture.
Door slam/wind loads, latch/hinge endurance, egress and movement interlock architecture; enddoor sweep against actual endplatform/gangway and adjacent vehicles.
Station rack foundation anchors, handling trolley and separate detached-handrail storage bracket. Complete purchased storage cabinet and its mounting hardware.
Station transition hinge needs a compatible continuous tread cover over interknuckle gaps; cover selection and attachment remain open.
Bridge whole-assembly load test, joint/handrail socket qualification, wear and handling assessment; no rated capacity issued.

Securement current OEM installation drawing, approved short-track lengths and first-hole phase, exact retractor anchorage point within its housing, device attachment points, occupant shoulder/lap routing and load qualification.
Bolts crossing existing seat rails require resolved sleeves or a vendor-approved hole phase. Track fasteners remain reservations, not a released drill pattern.
Full WTORS installation approval and real mobility-device trials.

loadscreen.central_rail_pitch_transfer_note: Conservatively assign the entire front-end300lbf reaction and6in pin offset to one rail joint; central throughbolt plus compression contact at1in box edge transfers pitch moment. Local rail bottom wall, prying and actual contact stiffness remain open.

loadscreen.combined_probe_limit: Combines maximum net bending and maximum gross closed-cell torsion conservatively; holes and local tube-wall force introduction remain separate qualification holds.

assembly: Preposition internal sleeves through open box ends; no welded aluminum joint.
Mate machined endmember and stringers; insert lower bolts and access central nuts through open forward stringer ends before deck closure.
Tongue nuts remain above outboard tongue roots, accessible from above; no travel-route fastener projections.
Fit relocated front handrail sockets/pins/cotters as a unit; top rail retains original overhang geometry.
Use dissimilar-metal isolation/coating and qualified prevailing torque installation; no friction-only force credit.
holds: Designer load probes only, not a bridge rating or accepted load spectrum.
Gross/net elastic beam screen does not qualify local tube-wall bearing, washer prying, notch fatigue, extrusion corner properties, bolt preload retention or handrail bracket combined loading.
Full grillage/deck connection distribution and moving dead-load center of gravity remain unqualified; 600lbf patch and500lbf wheel screens remain separate.
Header end tube-hole sections and combined bending/torsion require final local analysis/test; no strength is credited to thin endplate as an isolated transverse beam.
Fabricate to certified unwelded6061-T6 minimum35ksi yield; steel fastener proof comparison is conditional on actual Grade8 procurement.
